qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Iberian commercial office, logistics, and shopping centre portfolio with prime Madrid/Barcelona locations; sub-3% ROIC fails the 12% hurdle, and high-capex pivot to data centres requires heavy equity dilution and execution risk.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC = 2.7%, REJECT). Spain's largest REIT fails capital efficiency hurdles with unlevered portfolio yields of 4.5-5.5% and historical ROIC under 3%. High-capex data centre pivot brings substantial equity dilution and execution risk.
qualitative.evidence: Merlin Properties is Spain's largest SOCIMI with ~€11.5B GAV across Madrid/Barcelona offices (50%+), logistics (25%+), and shopping centres. 5-year average ROIC sits between 2.5% and 3.0%, well below the 12% hurdle. Net debt stands at €3.35B (~28% LTV, ~8.8x net debt/EBITDA). A €1B equity capital increase was executed in mid-2024 to fund data centre development across Madrid, Barcelona, and the Basque Country, illustrating high capital intensity and external financing dependence.
